Final for Publication

TYPE I ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS 2901-05 SOUTH LOWE AVENUE
FROM RS 3TO RM 4.5

Applicant seeks a Type | Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the
current RS 3 District to that of an RM 4.5 District for the property commonly known 2901-05
South Lowe Avenue. The site is improved with an existing single-family home at 2901
South Lowe Avenue and a vacant south side yard lot. Applicant seeks to subdivide the
zoning lot, which is 50 feet in width, into two zoning lots. The resulting northern lot, 2901 S.
Lowe Ave., will be 25 feet in width and maintain the existing single-family residence. The
resulting southern lot, 2905 S. Lowe Ave., will be 25 feet in width. Itis proposed to be
improved with a three residential dwelling unit building as part of the present zoning
amendment application.

The following is a list of the proposed bulk and density of the development:
2901 SOUTH LOWE AVENUE (all calculations are existing without proposal to alter)

Lot Area: 3,200 square feet

Density: 1 residential dwelling units (existing)

Floor Area: approximately 2,819 square feet (existing)
Floor Area Ratio: approximately 0.88 (existing)

Front Setback: approximately 13.65 feet (existing)

Rear Setback: approximately 30 feet (existing)

North Side Setback: approximately 0.76 feet (existing)

South Side Setback: approximately 3.24 feet (after subdivision)

seeks all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.
Specifically, seeking Variation for reduced required front and rear setbacks.
